subject: CYCLE-1 FINDING P0 INNER-WAKE: current main still collapses evidence between physical wake and useful/interactive inner presentation
body: Primary audited current main at a95cc839244159e100b50ef8f2ef1622adc14b33. The opening edge and WakeInner path are correctly separated from semantic hinge authority and generation-fenced. However, the app -> Binder -> shell wake path currently proves the physical inner power call and aggregate latency, then relies on later generic topology/render observations. The required staged causal chain (logical discovery/enable/power, display callbacks/state, first Choreographer/frame/transaction/expected-present, FIRST_USEFUL and FIRST_INTERACTIVE) is not joined to the same opening attempt in the inspected current-main path. This leaves the central INNER first-open P0 diagnostically ambiguous even when wakeInnerDisplay returns ok. Cycle-2 should add attempt-correlated sparse milestones using the existing TransitionEvent schema without granting diagnostics any semantic/routing authority. Fold7 physical validation remains required.
